title: RollupRecomputeResponse
description: The result of recomputing one group's rollups.

dryRun.description: Whether this was a report-only run.

reason.description: Why nothing was applied: UNCHANGED, NO_MEMBERS or DRY_RUN.

changed.description: Fields whose derived value differs from the stored one.

before.description: Previous values of the changed fields.

after.description: Newly derived values of the changed fields. firstPsvCompleteAt is the first time the group's status reached PSV Complete, or the time of the call if its history cannot place it.

closedToNewJoins.description: Whether this call closed the group to new tenant joins. Permanent.
